items.title: IDFC First Bank Q4 profit up 5% on lower provisions; fraud hits ops 42%
items.description: IDFC First Bank reported a modest 5% rise in Q4 net profit, aided by a 40% decline in provisions. However, a Rs 645-crore fraud at its Chandigarh branch sharply dented operating performance, leading to a 42% drop in operating profit after the bank fully expensed the impact during the quarter.

items.title: Axis Bank Q4 profit dips on higher provisions, trading loss
items.description: Axis Bank's net profit saw a slight dip in the fourth quarter. This was impacted by trading losses and a new provision for potential risks. Despite this, asset quality improved. The bank also saw growth in advances and deposits. A dividend has been recommended, and plans for capital raising are in place.

items.title: Uco Bank Q4 profit jumps 23% on lower provisions; margins dip
items.description: State-owned Uco Bank reported a 23% rise in Q4 net profit to Rs 801 crore, aided by lower provisions, though operating profit declined due to weaker core and non-interest income. Net interest margin slipped to 3%, even as advances grew 19.4% and deposits rose 11.6%.
